Maya K: FYI night-ops summary for release train 24 — short and actionable.
Release Bot: canary-alert: eu-west3 p95 spike detected 00:32-00:46 UTC.
Oliver: Noted. Impact scope?
Maya K: Canary-only, correlated with partner traffic burst (+~50% reqs). p95 peaked ~430ms, error-rate up ~1.8%.
Jamie (SRE): Throttled partner route at 00:48 UTC and added +1 canary replica; rolled back continuous_batching_v2 on affected shard at 00:55 UTC. Latency improving.
Tess: I'll monitor and post updates every 20m. If p95 >350ms for two windows I'll open an incident channel.
Maya K: Recommendation: extend canary by 2h and hold promotes until 03:00 UTC or explicit sign-off. No immediate rollback but prepare command below.
Maya K: rollback cmd: releasectl rollback --env=canary --to=v24-rc2 --reason="canary latency spike"
Oliver: Acknowledged. I'll gather model infra logs if needed.
Jamie (SRE): Current @01:07 UTC p95 ~200ms, errors 1.0%, trending down.
Maya K: Treat train 24 as quiet for now. I'll post final status when cleared. :thumbsup:
